name: Tiefling

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.description: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip. When you cast it using this trait, use the spellcasting ability chosen for your Tiefling Ancestry.

reviewNotes: Choose an Abyssal, Chthonic, or Infernal Ancestry to determine the inherited damage resistance and remaining innate magic. The shared Tiefling record is not itself selectable.
5.5e Fiendish Legacy replaces the 5.1-only Infernal Legacy assumption as the initial three-Ancestry baseline; 5.1 Infernal spell-level differences remain a separate comparison.

3.5e native-outsider creature classification and its three flat elemental resistances are not silently combined with the newer Humanoid and single-Ancestry resistance model. Creature-type and resistance reconciliation may revise this baseline.
Languages and learned traditions remain for Upbringing. Ability-score adjustments are deferred rather than imported from older editions.
